  gfm:

  echo: false

  message: false

unaltraweb_compute:
  engine: python
  mode: figure
  inputs:
    - assets/quarto/03-estructura-formats-referenciacio/tower-model-scene.svg
  outputs:
    - assets/img/generated/03-estructura-formats-referenciacio/tower-model-logical.svg
---

```{python}
from html import escape
from pathlib import Path
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

root = next(p for p in (Path.cwd(), *Path.cwd().parents)
            if (p / ".unaltraweb/computations.yml").is_file())
scene = (root / "assets/quarto/03-estructura-formats-referenciacio/tower-model-scene.svg").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
tree = ET.fromstring(scene)
towers = {e.attrib["data-tower-id"]: e.attrib for e in tree.iter() if "data-tower-id" in e.attrib}
spans = [e.attrib for e in tree.iter() if "data-span-id" in e.attrib]
labels = []
for span in spans:
    labels.append((int(span["data-label-x"]), 100, [
        f"{span['data-span-id']} · línia", f"Torre inicial: {span['data-start-tower']}",
        f"Torre final: {span['data-end-tower']}",
    ]))
for identifier, tower in towers.items():
    related = [s["data-span-id"] for s in spans if identifier in (s["data-start-tower"], s["data-end-tower"])]
    labels.append((int(tower["data-label-x"]), 450, [
        f"{identifier} · punt", f"Altura: {tower['data-height-m']} m", f"Trams: {' i '.join(related)}",
    ]))
annotations = ['<g id="annotations" font-family="Arial, Liberation Sans, sans-serif" font-size="28" fill="#21313c" text-anchor="middle">']
for x, y, lines in labels:
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        annotations.append(f'<text x="{x}" y="{y + 40*i}" font-weight="{700 if i == 0 else 400}">{escape(line)}</text>')
annotations.append('</g>')
scene = scene.replace("Torres i trams d'una mateixa xarxa", "Model lògic: punts, línies, identificadors i altures")
scene = scene.replace("<!-- model-annotations -->", "\n".join(annotations))
output = root / "assets/img/generated/03-estructura-formats-referenciacio/tower-model-logical.svg"
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_text(scene, encoding="utf-8")
```
